technology_name: STEEL FIBRE REINFORCED RUBCRETE PRESTRESSED CONCRETE RAILWAY SLEEPERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard concrete railway sleepers exhibit brittle fracture properties and suffer from insufficient impact energy absorption under heavy transit loads.
description: A high-performance structural railway sleeper fabricated from steel fiber-reinforced rubcrete, containing 10% crumb rubber particles (0.65 specific gravity) treated with 2% polyvinyl alcohol solution to deliver over two times the impact energy absorption.
applications: High-speed railway track infrastructure, heavy-haul freight rail lines, urban transit sleeper networks, and ballastless track structural bases.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
